_comment: Copy rulings that authorize a customer-facing GDPR letter, one record per ruling. This file is the ONLY source the
send gate trusts for a ruling id: adding one is a reviewed commit, never an edit on a host. `kind` must match the
letter being sent (ask|confirm), `expires` bounds it, and `source` says where the ruling was issued so a reader can
check the words rather than our summary of them.
